definition: A non-coding small nuclear RNA (snRNA) gene that forms an essential component of the spliceosome; pathogenic variants in RNU2-2 cause developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (DEE) and neurodevelopmental disorders manifesting with refractory seizures and profound intellectual and developmental impairment.

source.title: Pathogenic Variants in RNU2‐2, a Non‐coding Spliceosomal RNA, Cause a Distinctive Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathy
source.quote: RNU2-2 is a non-coding small nuclear RNA (snRNA) that forms part of the spliceosome.
